reviews.title: Pay-to-use. Literally.💔💔
reviews.text: I love this concept. The problem is that you get ads just every 3 or 4 letters! And they take forever to load. I would get it if you made people pay for letters with symbols above them or just symbols, but to pay for the whole font is CRAZY. I know other font apps make you pay, but at LEAST they have more than 1 type of font. Paying for one font is so unfair, and I don’t care about “it’s completely free! Just do the trial!” Make the main letters free at least. Key word least. But you guys are actually greedy with all the unnecessary ads and memberships for a font app with ONE font available, unlike the others that have hundreds. I get that it’s only one font because it’s your handwriting, but that should be the reason we don’t have to pay. It’s a very cool concept, but it obviously wasnt executed well. It takes FOREVER to finish an entire font set, only for it to waste users time and effort. Zero stars if I could.

It bothers me that it doesn’t say that UNTIL you download the app though. I get a lot of companies do this as it’s a more convincing way to get people to pay, I just personally dislike this method. You have to watch ads to make the keyboard itself. Also not a big deal! The developer(s) are probably getting paid when customers watch ads so I get it. BUT, when I went into my settings to give the app access to my keyboard, there was some shady agreement along the lines of they’re allowed to use whatever I type including personal information. A lot of these issues don’t bother me but you add them up and it’s sketchy.

reviews.title: TOTAL SCAM
reviews.text: I am infuriated by this app. POV: you download this app, spend an entire hour trying to perfect your font with half the time adverts being shoved in your face. I bashed my head about 30 times and I finally finished it. I try to test my font out but turns out I needed the ‘Premium Pass’ to test it out (by the way it was £17 per WEEK). So I tested it out on everything but it wasn’t on. So I tried to equip it, but that also required the ‘Premium Pass’. So, just to sum up the essay, THIS APP IS A SCAM! Developers,  if you start saying some weird things like “Thanks for downloading this app, I know that you want more flexibility with the app, blah blah blah,” don’t reply like that. I am sick with you saying this exact same thing to every other 1-star review as you never fix anything. So just start listening to your consumers and make the font free so you don’t get loads of one star reviews and more five star reviews. I hope you listened to this speech. I expect to see more. That’s it for me.

On top of that, the ads are ridiculous. I wrote only a few letters and already had to watch an ad and this almost happened every three letters, which made it incredibly slow and frustrating to use. Instead of being useful, it just felt like the app was constantly trying to force you to pay or watch ads. Also, don’t trust the ads where people recommend this app, because the actual experience is nothing like what they show.

I would not recommend downloading this app at all. It’s a complete waste of time because you can’t even properly use your own handwriting, and the nonstop ads make the experience even worse.

The thing is that when I finished everything, I was exited to use it but unfortunately it didn’t show up. No matter how much I tried, it wouldn’t work! So I wasted my WHOLE time on some scam. Please correct me if im wrong its just that im quite irritated. Fix it!

reviews.title: Terrible app.
reviews.text: Fontmaker is honestly really disappointing. It charges £15 a week just to be able to write in your own font, which is absolutely ridiculous for such a basic feature. On top of that, the app is extremely ad-heavy. You get ads constantly, which makes it frustrating and almost unusable. It feels more like a money grab than a helpful or fun app. Definitely not worth the price at all.

reviews.title: Terrible app.
reviews.text: I hate this app ALOT. There are like 30 ads in one alphabet trying to write the letters and I get you need to have ads to actually keep the app free but it reaches a point and there’s more ads than needed. I think I had like five ads in the span of like 30 seconds as well as this don’t even get to see your font for free you have to pay to see and that’s just like not fair. I don’t want to use the free trial cause I don’t wanna sign up to any subscriptions because I don’t trust them quite frankly please stop prioritising money over the actual purpose of the app.

reviews.title: I do not recommend this app at all!

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text:
Whilst it’s kind of fun to make, you get an advert literally every 4 letters you draw, and they’re not short either. So it took me like 30 mins just to do one alphabet…. Finally, the font looks like my handwriting and I actually like it, but I can’t even use it on my keyboard. The only way I can paste it is as a sticker which is stupid, and not the point. 

Find another app

reviews.title: Zero Stars. Period. READ BEFORE DOWNLOADING
reviews.text:
5 Stars so you can see. First off, let’s get this straight. I am not AI, I’m real. I’m not freaking out in all caps, this app’s not even worthy of freaking out about how bad it is. All the positive reviews are either fake or from Rich people with good jobs that can afford diamond necklaces and whatever. (The second isn’t likely).

WHAT YOU KNOW:
This app is not free whatsoever. Yeah, it works, sure. You get to make your own font, handwrite it, whatever. Your own personal font, yay.

THE PART THEY’RE NOT TELLING YOU: 
it’s a free app.
Sorry, my bad. I meant a “free” app.
You can make a font, do literally whatever you want to the letters, but once you’re done making the font, that’s the catch.
if you want to do anything with it including putting it in a text, posting some of it on social media, basically anything possible, it’s 15 dollars a week.
You heard me, 15 a WEEK. not month. WEEK. This is the most expensive and ripped off app I’ve seen in my entire life!
Don’t get me started on the ads. When you make the font, you do one letter at a time. Every three or four letters you get 2 two-minute long ads, so you actually spend more time watching ads than using the app. So here’s the timeline for a usual person who finds this app:

They see the app
“Yeah right that’s fake.”
They read some reviews all fake, maybe one real negative review, but overlook it as some unhappy customer.
They download it
They spend a hour or two making their font, exited (or more accurately watching ads)
T
